title: ANVISA alert access changed; other major sources stable
summary: ANVISA announced a new public alert consultation tool on July 6, 2026, replacing its earlier alert-search system. For most other safety databases currently visible in the application, this weekly check found no major public-source setup change affecting expected data freshness or availability as of Friday, July 17, 2026.
updates: ANVISA introduced a new alert consultation page on July 6, 2026 for public safety alerts, which may change how new Brazilian alert records appear or are searched in the app until that transition is fully aligned. [ANVISA notice](https://www.gov.br/anvisa/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-anvisa/2026/anvisa-disponibiliza-nova-ferramenta-para-consulta-de-alertas-sanitarios)

FDA published updated eMDR reporting milestones with a production change scheduled for July 20, 2026. This is an upstream reporting-system update rather than a confirmed public data outage, but it is being watched for any effect on future device reporting flows. [FDA eMDR update](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/emdr-electronic-medical-device-reporting/emdr-system-enhancements)
no_major_changes: FDA MAUDE, FDA Recall, FDA CDRH Recalls, FDA Safety Communications, BfArM, Swissmedic, MHRA, TGA DAEN, TGA DRAC, Health Canada DHPR, Canada Recall, AEMPS, ANSM, PMDA, and NMPA English showed no significant public setup or access change in this check.
